$comment: Every field is a measurement with its method, or the literal string "not measured", or "blocked: <what>".
device: web · Chromium 1440x950 · Apple silicon, WebGPU. NOT a device tier: no phone or tablet capture exists yet.

blinkRatePerMin.method: IdleEngine.step at 60Hz for 20 min, seeded, counting blinkStarted. Counted at the generator because the renderer neither adds nor drops a blink; blink TIMING relative to speech is blinkNearPausePct and is not this number. Target 12-20: inside it.

breathRatePerMin.method: Zero-up-crossings of breathY over the same 20 min run. Target 12-20: inside it. Period 4.28s with 7.4% cycle-to-cycle variation, against the +/-15% the audit asks for — the layer breathes more metronomically than specified. Cause is idleConfig.breath.rateHz spanning 0.2-0.27Hz, whose uniform re-randomisation yields ~8.7% by construction; reaching 15% needs a range wide enough to push the instantaneous rate below the 12/min floor, so the two targets conflict and the resolution is a design call, not an arithmetic one.

frameTimeP95Ms.method: requestAnimationFrame deltas in-page over 40s of idle, 2401 frames, taken in a pass with no screenshots running: a screenshot stalls the compositor, so a series captured alongside one measures the harness. p50 16.70, p95 17.70, p99 18.30 — vsync-locked at 60Hz with no long frames. This is the web tier only.

idlePeriodicityPeak.method: Autocorrelation peak past the first zero crossing, on motion measured from the COMPOSITED frame (fraction of pixels changing >2 grey levels between full-resolution screenshots, 14.9/s over 40s). Peak sits at 12.6s; against 200 AR(1) surrogates fitted to the signal's own smoothness, p=0.025 — not distinguishable from a smooth aperiodic signal. Not comparable to the generator's own coefficient, which measures 0.74 for the same underlying motion.
